notes.title: Update 0.10.14
notes.content:
Flavor text has been added to all modules to help players understand the gameplay and world setting. This text will appear when you hover over the name of a module on a panel displaying module information, or over an item on a screen, such as the module collection rate on the scoreboard.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added flavor text to all modules.
[*]Skill: [b]Archaic Rule[/b] prevents projectiles that have failed hit test from hitting the skill user as stray bullets. (Replicates behavior up to version 0.10.11)
[*]Skill: [b]Adaptive Defense[/b] increases defense based on damage taken in a previous round.
[*]Skill: [b]In-Order[/b] Modules with remaining AP do not take HP damage.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The game crashed when destroying the attack target in the DPS simulator.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]M.Cores (Balancer, Dream, Foreigner, General, Space, Sun, Tempest), Dragon Armor, and Barrage Laser Rev.B can now be crafted via modding.
[*]Improved rendering quality of partially colored text.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/cd4a34fbf1a34f15f120757317faeaca8725a4d3.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.13
notes.content:
Added skills to improve unwieldy weapons, such as those with a wide AoE radius or high heat-generating optical weapons.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]CATs: 1 small CAT and 6 normal-size CATs.
[*]Skill: [b]Compressed Explosion[/b] increases area damage instead of reducing the area of effect.
[*]Skill: [b]Overheat Radiation[/b] increases damage dealt by optical weapons in overheat state.
[*]Skill: [b]Heater Shield[/b] increases defense as heat level rises.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Occasionally crashed on startup, and this was more likely to occur with CPUs with more cores.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Blueprints and codices can now be used while exploring.
[*]The chance of unintentional hits to certain objects like CATs was reduced.
[*]Adjusted required attribute values and appearance areas for many skills. 
[*]Added a tab for moddable modules in the factory.
[*]Overall, reduced turn rates of cores/drives.
[*]Made it possible to destroy [b]Shield Systems[/b] with [b]Shield Neutralizer[/b]. 
[*]Adjusted skills and AI of some CATs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/2544882df023d5a16691d99d7ae81b6535e7cf51.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.12
notes.content:
A new facility called "Remote Factory" has been added to the exploration map (excluding First Cat Mode).
For existing save data, their maps will be updated if you return to the garage and then head out to explore.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Remote Factory[/b] is a facility where you can perform factory functions while exploring.
[*]Module: [b]Turret Overrider[/b] is a special weapon that turns enemy artillery and turrets to your side.
[*]Skill: [b]Sixth Sense[/b] displays the direction of a nearest enemy CAT.
[*]Skill: [b]Cyber Conversion[/b] removes the armor-ignoring trait of cyber weapons but increases their damage by 16 times.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The AP/HP gauges for friendly artillery and turrets had the same color as those for the enemy.
[*]Fixed: Status effect [b]Accidental Firing[/b] was not applied to [b]Flex Turrets[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved hit rates of [b]Grappling Hook[/b], [b]Remora Anchor[/b], and [b]Space Hopper[/b]. [b]Remora Anchor[/b] no longer requires ammunition.
[*][b]Grappling Hook[/b], [b]Remora Anchor[/b], and skills that target an object can now select static objects outside of sight.
[*]If a projectile fails in its hit-test to the target object upon firing and flies on a trajectory that intersects with the target, it will now be hit-tested as a stray shot, just like other objects.
[*]When a projectile hits something other than the object that passed the hit test at the time of firing and causes damage, it is now logged as an unintentional hit.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/854705a910a981046a0fa1cdd99fd592342f9f28.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.11
notes.content:
A certain number of allies (CATs, artillery/turrets, friendly sensors) are now placed on playfields in advance. The amount placed depends on the current layer and how many CATs you can deploy.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Skill: [b]Sniping[/b] increases accuracy when attacking without moving.
[*]Item: [b]Rollback Batch[/b] rewinds time to the previous round.
[*]Item: [b]Reset Batch[/b] rewinds time to the start of battle.
[*]Module: [b]Toxic Dartgun[/b] is a special weapon for the early stages that deals continuous damage.
[*]CATs: [b]Plankton[/b] and [b]Tsuchinoko[/b] are equipped with [b]Toxic DartGun[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The range of [b]Pulse Rifle[/b] and [b]Ion Storm[/b] was shorter than the displayed value.
[*]Fixed: When multiple effects that reduce a same parameter by a percentage were stacked, the reduction amount was displayed as -100%.
[*]Fixed: It was possible to summon any number of CATs using [b]Friend Phones[/b], contrary to the description.
[*]Fixed: Skill effects could not create walls or fences on squares where floor-type objects were placed.
[*]Fixed: The effect range of [b]Wall Generator[/b] was different from what was displayed.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Further expansion of playfield variations.
[*]The probability of friendly CATs and turrets being generated on a playfield has increased.
[*]Removed [b]Energy Usage +100%[/b] from the debuffs granted by [b]Terminals[/b] and [b]Virus Barrels[/b].
[*]Added an image when exiting the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/29ffe3a2029c7b4b4f730fab8e1bf5bf6bbbef51.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.10
notes.content:
The probability of generating chests and the expected value of items obtained when destroying boxes, barrels, pots, etc. have been slightly buffed.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Object: [b]Potted Plant[/b] — When destroyed, there is a low chance of obtaining an item. (Same type of object as [b]Pot[/b])
[*]Item: [b]Friend Phone[/b] summons a random CAT that will be your ally for the duration of a battle.
[*]Status effect: [b]Teleportation Sickness[/b] causes random teleportation at random times.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enhanced variety of playfields.
[*]Information is now displayed when the pointer hovers over items in the inventory screen.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/ec40536fa44540dbba0db01a9298c9afcb0c326f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.9
notes.content:
This and the next few updates will focus on expanding the variety of playfields (battle maps).

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Vending Machine[/b] is a device that can be unlocked repeatedly to obtain random items in exchange for pixels.
[*][b]Ice Wall[/b] is a wall that lowers the heat levels of the surrounding environment.
[*][b]Drone Attractor[/b] is a type of alarm that gathers drones within a playfield.
[*][b]Thicket[/b] and [b]Liquid Wall[/b] can be passed through, but they partially block sensors and projectiles. (Similar to [b]Dark Zone[/b])
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Predicted energy increase/decrease rates are now displayed in the command menu during battle scenes.
[*]🐈 .NET runtime is included. This is a countermeasure for environment-dependent issues.
[/list]

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/ec95438612d849b2d44a3a5119d8b9bb76b36e18.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.8
notes.content:
New upgrades have been added to all carriers except Bomber-Shark.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Ammo Box Installation[/b] ([b]Sea-Dragon[/b]) installs an ammo box.
[*][b]Anti-Sensor Coating[/b] ([b]Aqua-Manta[/b]) gives a status effect that prevents detection under 25% Visibility.
[*][b]Make Friends[/b] ([b]Sky-Dolphin[/b]) turns a neutral CAT into an ally.
[*][b]Mining-Rig Installation[/b] ([b]Minor-Whale[/b]) installs a rig that moves forward while destroying obstacles.
[*]Skill: [b]Multi-Missile 3x[/b] triples the number of guided missiles fired by other skill effects.
[*]Enemy CATs: Magicbolt, Pluton
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Replay did not work properly when using [b]Extra Deployment[/b] of [b]Minor-Whale[/b].
[*]Fixed: The movement distance of some objects was different from their Movement.
[*]Fixed: Debuffs such as [b]Damage Taken +100%[/b] were not applied to [b]Rotating Floor[/b].
[*]Fixed: Ammo explosion damage was sometimes not displayed correctly in the battle log.
[*]Fixed: In the battle log, some optical weapons' damage was sometimes mixed up with other weapons' damage.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Dark Zone[/b] now blocks some projectiles, mainly from optical and cyber weapons.
[*]Improved AI of Block Breaker, which refrains from ineffective attacks.
[*]Improved AI when attacking static objects outside of sensing range.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/e5ef8dc8f2bf13f9b824c0881209e9971711504a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.7
notes.content:
CAT Builder tutorials can be run from an event placed when a new game is started.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added tutorials for the CAT Builder.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: In CAT stats, 1 was added per connector to the displayed value of maximum energy consumption.
[*]Fixed: The description of [b]Sensing +X%[/b] (skill) sometimes differed from its actual effect.
[*]Fixed: In First Cat mode, if a broken module was equipped at the beginning of a battle, pixels were significantly reduced at the end of the battle.
[*]Fixed: Processor utilization was excessively high while the window was minimized.
[*]Fixed: The frame rate of background drawing was low when the DPS simulator was turned off in the CAT Builder test screen.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved the algorithm for automatic module replacement in the CAT Builder.
[/list]

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/bc5bd1fe461ad620f954c81e61b37accaa94c39b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.6
notes.content:
Update to add skills and to reduce clicks by extending automatic controls.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Skill: [b]Body Swap[/b] swaps positions with another CAT of the same size.
[*]Skill: [b]Optimization ES-80%[/b] reduces shield energy consumption by 80% for shields at maximum durability.
[*]Skill: [b]Photosynthesis[/b] allows users to avoid consuming carrier energy.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Most passive skills now support automatic control mode.
[*]Adjusted prices for ammo packs and carrier upgrades.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/5a96c28b394757c2773bd79ab61e5d060cc1bd42.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.5
notes.content:
[h3]Redesign[/h3]
[list]
[*]🐈The tutorial has been redesigned as a step-by-step guide.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The tutorial completion achievement cannot be unlocked in First Cat mode.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]An [b]Emergency Patch[/b] can now also restore Armor Points to a targeted module.
[/list]

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/7b46d53fd5f40895532057b2d686254b2e89a930.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.4
notes.content:
Through ongoing tweaks to weapon parameters and fixes to bugs that had a significant impact on short-range weapons, the practicality of melee weapons has been greatly improved.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Module: [b]Fishing Spear[/b] is a high-DPS melee weapon that can be used early in the game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Some melee weapons ([b]Stinger[/b], [b]Pile Driver[/b], [b]Unicorn[/b], [b]Laser Needle[/b], [b]Blast Lance[/b]) could never hit the target when used at the edge of their range.
[*]Fixed: When attacking while approaching from out of range, the first shot would always miss.
[*]Fixed: A CAT in a confused state would attack ignoring the firing angle limit.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the effect of [b]Chest of Ray[/b]. Area damage → Fires beams in all directions.
[*]Merged W, X, and Y mod kits.
[*]The disadvantages of the skills [b]Rapid Boot +100%[/b] and [b]Ramming[/b] have been reduced.
[*]Improved readability of area damage/effect logs.
[*]Text displayed sequentially in dialogs now immediately follows language changes.
[*]Weapons with a long time remaining before the next shot will have a reduced contribution to the turn direction decision.
[*]Improved CAT behavior when attacking out-of-view coordinates where a static object is present.
[*]Added a visual effect when an object is triggered by an effect of another object.
[*]Event icons now change depending on the event state.
[*]Updated graphics for shields with Ap/Ai/At/Ae derivatives.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/e47ae75284a9956901425c22e646ced623b73e1d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.10.3
notes.content:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a feature to modify modules (create derived modules) in the factory.
[*]Added hundreds of derived modules and tweaked the performance balance.
[*]Added 24 types of enemy CATs.
[*]Expanded a variety of effects when a terminal is successfully unlocked.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Some events were not displayed in tutorials other than First Cat mode.
[*]Fixed: Some events limited to First Cat mode were also displayed in other modes.
[*](patch-1) Fixed: Localization error in the pilot name "Venetian".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/596217886273ac44293b10d0610a1260f1d4ea35.png[/img]

notes.content:

[list]
[*]Item: [b]Cleanup Batch[/b] removes buffs and debuffs that expire over time.
[*]Supported manual setting of display scaling factor.

[list]

notes.title: Update 0.10.1
notes.content:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]🐈Added [b]First Cat[/b] game mode (difficulty) for beginners.
This mode is designed for beginners and allows you to focus on playing CAT battles.
To make the game system easier to understand , the following elements are disabled.
[list]
[*]Garage
[*]Events: Portal, Energy Station, Repair Station, Remote Repository, Arena, Pixel Mining
[*]Carrier: Energy, Storage, Upgrade
[*]Story
[*]Pilot Motivation
[*]Gifts, Blueprints, Codices, Pixel Packs, Energy Packs
[/list]
All CATs are fully recovered after each battle in exchange for pixels. As a result, your pixels may go negative, but there is no penalty other than not being able to buy items in the shops.
As you progress through each layer, one pilot is added, and the game is completed when you conquer the fourth floor.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Some data was missing from the statistics when the game was completed.
[*]Fixed: The layout of the tooltip for "Required Attributes" may break.
[*]Fixed: In the Result dialog, the rendering of some modules may be distorted and the orientation is not reflected.
[*]Fixed: A CAT recovering from [b]Confusion[/b] or [b]Berserk[/b] would continue to attack allies during the round.
[*]Fixed: Clicking on a CAT outside the visible area targeted for auto-attack would deselect it.
[/list]
[h3]Other Modifications[/h3]
[list]
[*]🐈Adjusted overall weapon performance. Here are the major changes.
[table]
[tr]
[th]Buffs[/th]
[td]Burst Artillery, Practical Cannon, Blazing Cannon, Charged EM Cannon, Purgatory,
Chain Pile, Pile Driver, Combat Batton, Harpoon Cannon, Plasma Blade, Eraser[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Nerfs[/th]
[td]Basic Missile, Fast Missile, Polar Star, Dividing Missle,
Purger, Shooting Star, Backdoor Missile[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[*]Increased pixels gained from scrapped modules that could not be looted after battle.
[*]🐈Changed the equipment for [b]Base Metal[/b].
[*]Removed the prerequisite skill for [b]Evasion +8[/b].
[*]Adjusted sector generation parameters.
[*]Improved item drop rate when destroying objects.
[/list]

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/fc0fd6cff8659b19f531c699d65da806546bee3c.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 0.9.4 Demo
notes.content:
[h3]General Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]🐈Arena entry fee has been made free.
[*]Energy costs when returning directly to the garage have been made free.
[*]House Cat difficulty: Repair costs at repair stations have been lowered.
[*]House Cat difficulty: Energy and repair costs at the garage have been reduced.
[*]🐈Added rewards for victory in capture battles.
[*]🐈House Cat difficulty: Added rewards for defeating CATs other than child CATs.
[*]🐈Added various shortcut key assignments.
[*]🐈Added a batch operation button to CAT Move and Attack menu.
[*]🐈Added explanation of effects to some object information.
[*]🐈CATs within range of explosives will now avoid attacking those explosives. (Except for weapons with individual target settings and targets with "High" attack priority.)
[*]🐈Static cloaked objects will now be visible once detected, even if visibility is below 100%.
[*]🐈Rings around control systems and other objects can be seen even if they overlap with the field.
[*]The mouse cursor is hidden when using a gamepad.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: When a moving object set as an attack target is outside the sensor range, the "!" icon does not appear in the attack menu.
[*]Fixed: The key/button operation to create a new CAT is enabled on the screen for selecting a pilot to board.
[*]🐈Fixed: Corrected Distress Beacon dialog title.
[/list]
Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!
